maya: quick sync - we're seeing persistent small deltas between billing exports and trace-derived costs for compacted envelopes. suspect late-enrich attributes lost post-compaction.
ton y: can you point to stage? ingress compactor runs before late-enrich join, right?
elena: correct. compactor prunes attrs to hit envelope size targets. sometimes late-enrich adds billing.owner/billing.sku which never make it into the compacted keyset.
maya: simplest thought: keep a named-preserve list (_preserve: [billing.*]) so compactor keeps those keys. but that hurts compact goals.
sam: alternative hybrid: write a tiny provenance bitset into the compact envelope for a few critical billing keys (very small overhead) + emit a sidecar with full late attrs when needed.
elena: bitset seems low-cost. sidecar gives fidelity but requires storage and fast lookup. GC and cross-shard lookup complexity are real concerns.
ton y: also consider sampling: if trace is sampled out before late-enrich, stitcher may never see the trace to attribute cost. need fallback.
maya: decision criteria: minimize steady-state size, preserve correctness for high-value customers, and give observability when we fail.
sam: concrete proposal: 1) compactor V2 writes billing_bitset (uint32) into CompactMeta; 2) sidecar LateAttrsSidecar written async to TTL bucketed store + short-lived redis index for fast lookups. Sidecar emitted for heavy customers/routes or when bitset indicates presence and route is billing-sensitive.
elena: config: key->bit index mapping maintained centrally; compactor reads mapping. compactor supports optional schema v2 flag so older compactors still work.
ton y: rollout: enable bitset write for 10% of edge nodes; sidecar for 1% traffic of heavy customers. monitor mismatch metric. ops-bot: scheduled deploy compactor-v2 canary -> 2026-04-22T20:00Z
maya: instrumentation: stitcher emits cost.attribution.missed when sidecar/join fails; emits cost.attribution.fallback when using approximate route-hint attribution. dashboards: per-customer delta between billing export and trace-derived cost.
sam: protos (sketch):```message CompactMeta { int64 compact_id = 1; uint32 billing_bitset = 2; int64 ts_ms = 3; } message LateAttrsSidecar { int64 compact_id = 1; map<string,string> attrs = 2; int64 ts_ms = 3; }```
elena: storage plan: sidecars -> TTL-bucketed object store (10m) + redis index for 2m. GC: index sweeper removes redis keys; object store lifecycle takes care of long tail.
ton y: security: sidecar must not contain PII. add whitelist at ingest-time and an enforcement test.
maya: edge cases: model-routing fallback might change billing.sku between request and enrichment; sidecar should capture pre-enrich hint and post-enrich final sku when available. bitset only signals presence.
sam: perf: bitset ~4 bytes; sidecar write async. we'll load test to validate tail latency remains within SLOs.
elena: compatibility: stitcher treats missing billing_bitset as zero. no backfill for old data.
ton y: consumer integration: stitcher does time-window join (compact_id + 5m window). on missing sidecar, emit metric and fallback logic.
maya: action items: elena -> compactor PR (include compat tests). sam -> infra ticket for sidecar storage/index + GC. tony -> define canary monitoring checklist. maya -> dashboard + alert (cost.attribution.missed > 5/min triggers ops). ops-bot: noted and will page if threshold exceeded.
maya: thanks, will follow up in PR thread and post dashboard link when ready.
